decisions.reason: The doc-file and manual-entry workflow concerns KDP listing material, not the required back matter or author biography content.
The source specifies the delivery and entry method for KDP listing material but does not change the requested guidance about publication prerequisites.
The KDP listing-material workflow does not select, replace, or otherwise change the paperback cover design.
Sending listing material in a doc file for manual entry does not change the paperback format or trim size.
The source does not change the copyright-page publication attribution line; the shared publication terminology is incidental.
The doc file contains KDP listing material and does not alter the manuscript's copyediting or proofreading requirements.
The KDP manual-entry method has no necessary effect on chapter-heading punctuation, capitalization, or hierarchy.
The source concerns copying KDP listing material and does not change chapter-image coverage, placement, or presentation.
The referenced doc file is for KDP listing material, not a replacement authoritative manuscript file or a change to manuscript content.
The listing-material transfer and manual-entry method does not affect chapter-image distortion, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
The source does not modify the approved title text or the requirement to exclude the unintended newline marker.
